relations: Brawley 与 Vero：伴侣，Vero 只把他登记为唯一紧急联系人（原文 “he listed you as his emergency contact. Only you.”；“I love the way that feels.”）
Brawley 与 Kayla：由占有欲转为接纳并确立三人关系（原文 “She belongs to us.”；“I will make sure what happened at the bar never happens again, you have my word.”）
Vero 与 Kayla：伴侣式的相互滋养，Vero 依赖她的在场（原文 “Tell me we can keep her. She is perfect for us.”；“he heals a part of my soul every time we are together”）
Clay 与 Kayla：嘴上装作她什么都不是，其实已被她影响（原文 “as much as Clay likes to pretend she means nothing, she has gotten under his skin.”）
Ares 与 Kayla：自认要把她研究透彻，Brawley 点破这意味着他在乎（原文 “Ares has convinced himself that she is someone he needs to figure out, but what he doesn’t or can’t understand is that in Ares-land, it means he cares.”）

facts.fact: Brawley 看到 Kayla 在沙发上教 Vero 钩毛线，看不下去，决定趁夜色去绕岛跑一圈；跑过 freak museum 时撞见坐在翻倒木箱上的 Banks
facts.anchor: Right now, they are on the couch, and she is teaching Vero how to crochet. It is the single most boring thing I have witnessed in my entire life.

facts.fact: Brawley 质问 Banks 给 Vero 植入了什么，Banks 答 “Just a tiny GPS tracker”，说明用途是让 Brawley 能找到他、避免他再次伤到别人
facts.anchor: “Just a tiny GPS tracker. He wants you to be able to find him so he doesn’t hurt anyone again.”

facts.fact: Banks 补充这东西同时是微芯片，而 Vero 把 Brawley 列为唯一紧急联系人：“Only you.”，Brawley 听后用手抹了脸
facts.anchor: “It also acts as a microchip, and he listed you as his emergency contact. Only you.”

facts.fact: Banks 说 Kayla 跟着 Vero 来过，并在他的博物馆里待了 two hours——Vero 一直讲要怎么把她身上的纹身取下来，而她只是看、不问也不碰任何东西；他还判断她走路小心、进每间房都先记出口
facts.anchor: Then she sat in my museum for two hours, while he went on about capturing her tattoos right, and she looked at everything.

facts.fact: Brawley 回屋后发现一地毛线，上楼看见 Kayla 骑坐在 Vero 腿上；Kayla 说 Vero 在他走后只撑了 “about seven minutes” 就宣布无聊、开始编绳套，还把绳套往脖子上套，Vero 辩解那 “is just a big knot”
facts.anchor: “He lasted about seven minutes after you left, then announced he was bored and started trying to make a noose.”

facts.fact: 三人上床后 Vero 请求 “Tell me we can keep her. She is perfect for us.”；Kayla 不要他乱保证，只要他 “Just promise you will try.”，Brawley 随即向 Vero 承诺 “I promise to try”
facts.anchor: Don’t make promises you can’t keep. Just promise you will try.

facts.fact: Kayla 主动亲吻 Brawley，Brawley 承认自己从没让被他上过的女人亲过他、那部分只留给 Vero，但 “she makes me want to give it to her too”，事后他断言 “She belongs to us.” 并不许外人看到她这样
facts.anchor: Never have I let a woman we fuck kiss me before now. There is something intimate about the action, and I refuse to allow anyone but Vero to have that part of me. Yet somehow she makes me want to give it to her too.

facts.fact: Vero 睡着后 Kayla 说原谅他：“I don’t understand why people don’t like him—he is authentically himself, and I love that about him”，并说 “he heals a part of my soul every time we are together”；Brawley 承诺酒吧的事不会再发生，Kayla 说 “the sex—that’s a bonus”
facts.anchor: It’s hard not to forgive him. I don’t understand why people don’t like him—he is authentically himself, and I love that about him. And I really meant it when I said he heals a part of my soul every time we are together.
